name: Mr Satou
source:
Scion to a prestigious family, Lilly's and Akira's father is a dignified and traditional man whose primary purpose in life involves guiding the company he inherited from his father to even greater heights.

After moving to Scotland in order to take up the mantle of executive, Mister Satou's goal of corporate success seems to be within his grasp, but his work-life balance appears to have suffered a lot as a result.
